pgoTraining.scope: Only compiler check; the two fixtures and build emission were not training commands.

notes: Every series used three warmup pairs and 30 alternating measured pairs with unchanged stdout hash and exit status.
No task-owned builds or tests ran during measurements. Unrelated host load varied between series.
PGO compilation is an explicit one-time build stage; ordinary ReleaseFast is retained as the baseline.
The source-only probe optimization and the same-source PGO control are recorded separately to distinguish their contributions.
Peak RSS increased with PGO; the historical 30% RAM/time target is not achieved.
